name: Lateral Meniscus Root Tear
definition: Tear near the posterior or anterior root attachment of the lateral meniscus, often associated with ACL injury and capable of altering meniscal load transmission.

investigations.principle: MRI is the key study for root tear and associated ligament/chondral pathology.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Activity modification while diagnosis is clarified
amber: Repair is considered in appropriate tears to restore meniscal function, especially in younger/active patients.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Snayu phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Tear near the posterior or anterior root attachment of the lateral meniscus, often associated with ACL injury and capable of altering meniscal load transmission.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
